tools.description: Explicitly finish the run with a user-facing result when the requested work is complete. This tool is optional when the configured no-tool policy allows natural completion; the runtime still enforces unfinished-TODO checks.
tools.name: task_finish

exposed_files.description: Workspace-relative deliverable paths to expose to the user.

require_all_todos_completed.description: Reject finish while TODOs remain unless false.

tools.description: Pause for a required user decision that cannot be discovered safely with available tools. Ask one concrete question and provide concise options when useful.
tools.name: ask_user

allow_custom_options.description: Whether users can add custom options.

options.description: Optional answer options shown to the user.

question.description: Question text to ask the user.

selection_type.description: Single or multi-choice mode when options are provided.

tools.description: Load one skill listed in the current available-skills metadata. Use the exact skill name and follow the returned instructions; unlisted names are rejected.
tools.name: activate_skill

reason.description: Optional reason for activating this skill.

skill_name.description: Skill identifier from available skill list.

tools.description: Replace the current structured TODO list. Send the complete list, keep at most one item in_progress, and use stable ids when updating existing items.
tools.name: todo_write

id.description: Existing TODO id for update; omit for new item. When omitted, a generated 8-character id is assigned.

priority.description: TODO priority: `high` for blockers or user-critical work, `medium` for normal required work, `low` for cleanup or optional follow-up.

status.description: TODO status: `pending` for not started, `in_progress` for the single active item, or `completed` after verification.

title.description: TODO title. Make it actionable and observable, so progress can be verified without reading hidden context.

tools.description: List workspace files with path, glob, visibility, pagination, and sorting controls. Results are bounded and report truncation/count hints; paths remain subject to workspace policy.
tools.name: find_files

include_hidden.description: Whether hidden files and dotfiles are included.

include_ignored.description: When listing workspace root, include files under common dependency/cache directories.

include_sensitive.description: Include files whose paths look like secrets, credentials, keys, tokens, or private config.

max_results.description: Maximum number of file paths returned in one call.

offset.description: Number of matching file paths to skip before returning results.

scan_limit.description: Maximum files scanned before stopping early to keep listing fast.

tools.description: Inspect workspace path metadata without reading file contents. Returns normalized type, size, modified time, suffix, and line-count information when available.
tools.name: file_info

path.description: Target file path (workspace-relative by default; absolute path allowed when outside-workspace access is enabled).

tools.description: Read bounded UTF-8 text from a workspace path. Use a line range for targeted reads or the returned cursor to continue an oversized read; stale cursors are rejected if the source changes.
tools.name: read_file

end_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive last line; incompatible with cursor.

show_line_numbers.description: Prefix returned lines with source line numbers.

start_line.description: Optional 1-based first line; incompatible with cursor.

cursor.description: Continuation state returned by a previous read of this path.

tools.description: Create, overwrite, or append text in the workspace. Overwrite is the default; use append and newline controls only when preserving existing content is intentional.
tools.name: write_file

append.description: Set true to append instead of overwrite.

content.description: The complete file body for overwrite mode, or the exact block to append when `append=true`.

leading_newline.description: Add a leading newline when appending.

path.description: Target file path (workspace-relative by default; absolute path allowed when outside-workspace access is enabled).

trailing_newline.description: Add a trailing newline when appending.

tools.description: Replace exact text in a workspace file using the current read/write baseline. The match must be unique unless replace_all is true, and changed files or stale baselines are rejected.
tools.name: edit_file

path.description: Target file path (workspace-relative by default; absolute path allowed when outside-workspace access is enabled).

replace_all.description: Replace all matches when true after confirming every match is intended.

tools.description: Search workspace text with regex and smart-case by default; set literal for exact text. Scope with path, glob, or type. Results are bounded and return truncation/pagination metadata.
tools.name: search_files

c.description: Context lines before and after each match.

glob.description: Optional file glob filter such as `**/*.rs`.

head_limit.description: Cap output to the first N rows or entries.

include_hidden.description: Whether hidden files and dotfiles are included.

include_ignored.description: When searching workspace root, include files under common dependency/cache directories.

include_sensitive.description: Include files whose paths look like secrets, credentials, keys, tokens, or private config.

literal.description: Search for the exact pattern text instead of interpreting it as a regex.

n.description: Whether to include line numbers in content output.

offset.description: Number of result rows or entries to skip before returning results.

path.description: Optional search root or single file path.

pattern.description: Regex pattern, or exact text when literal is true.

type.description: File type shortcut such as py, js, ts, md, or json.

tools.description: Run a command in the configured workspace shell. Prefer specialized file tools for direct file work. Long commands may run in the background; oversized terminal output returns a head/tail preview and a workspace artifact path for complete recovery.
tools.name: bash

auto_confirm.description: Pipe yes to the command for non-interactive confirmation prompts.

command.description: Command to execute through the configured shell.

exec_dir.description: Execution directory (workspace-relative by default; absolute path allowed when outside-workspace access is enabled).

run_in_background.description: Start asynchronously and return a session id.

stdin.description: Optional stdin content for interactive prompts, confirmation text, heredoc-style input, or commands that read from standard input.

timeout.description: Foreground timeout seconds; bounded by the schema.

tools.description: Read the current state and bounded output of a background command by session id. Terminal oversized output uses the same preview-and-artifact result as foreground bash.
tools.name: check_background_command

tools.description: Run one task, or independent batch tasks, on a configured sub-agent. Use the exact agent id, keep tasks self-contained, and choose background execution only when the parent can continue independently.
tools.name: create_sub_task

agent_id.description: Exact sub-agent identifier from the configured `sub_agents` mapping.

exclude_files_pattern.description: Optional portable regex applied to normalized workspace-relative paths for child discovery only.

include_main_summary.description: Whether to include parent-task summary context.

output_requirements.description: Optional output constraints for single-task mode.

task_description.description: Single-task description for one self-contained objective.

tasks.description: Batch mode: multiple independent tasks for the same sub-agent.

output_requirements.description: Optional output constraints for one sub-task. State success criteria, expected format, concrete deliverables, and verification evidence.

task_description.description: Task description for one independent sub-task. Give a concrete objective, relevant constraints, files or commands, and the evidence or deliverable expected by the parent Agent.

tools.description: Inspect configured sub-task ids, optionally wait, or send one follow-up message to the first id. Snapshot mode adds recent activity and bounded workspace-file evidence.
tools.name: sub_task_status

message.description: Optional follow-up or steering message for the first task id.

wait_for_response.description: When `message` is provided, wait until the task finishes processing that message.

workspace_file_limit.description: Maximum number of workspace files returned per task in snapshot mode.

tools.description: Attach a supported workspace image or HTTP image URL to the next model turn. Local files remain subject to workspace policy, format checks, and the inline size limit.
tools.name: read_image

path.description: Image path or URL to attach.
